fields.reasoning: The change set has no intent; the earlier test-suite fix (test-suite-shared, under self-check) served milestone-25, and this is the same kind of backlog test-hygiene work, so it serves the same intent. For cleanup, the leak comes from go test timeouts killing the binary before TestMain's removal runs, so only cleanup at the next start is reliable. Sweeping by prefix and an hour's age works for bare go test, CI and make test alike, and leaves alone folders a concurrent run in another worktree is still using (make test runs many worktrees on one machine, and timing budgets finish well within an hour). A per-run directory deleted by make test would not help ad-hoc go test runs, and a run killed with make would leak it the same way. The hour threshold and prefixes come from the change set's own intent.
fields.statement: The change set serves milestone-25 (the backlog intent), as test-suite-shared did. Each package that makes a fixed-prefix temp folder (internal/api rhiza-api-budget-*, internal/index rhiza-index-budget-*, internal/slice rhiza-slice-budget-*, internal/quiettest rhiza-quiet-*) removes its own stale folders when it starts: those under os.TempDir() with its prefix whose modification time is older than an hour, through one small shared helper, with a test that a stale folder goes and a fresh one stays. No per-run directory that make test deletes.
